guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: adservice_socket is the strongest anomaly in the digest (3 -> 4.13, +37.7%, z=+7.55), with adservice_mem also up 22.4% (z=+4.47), while no other series exceeds |z|~1.5. However, adservice does not appear in the service map or in any of the worst traces (which are errored in frontend and pass through currencyservice/productcatalogservice), and there are no error or warning logs, so the link between adservice and the alert is not established.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect adservice connection handling for leaked or lingering sockets and, if confirmed, restart or roll back the adservice pod after verifying that frontend errors correlate with adservice calls. Take no destructive action until that correlation is confirmed.
